mainEntity.name: Is ceramic tile better than other flooring options for my kitchen or bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing ceramic tile with other flooring, focus on durability, moisture resistance, maintenance, and cost. Ceramic tile is often a strong choice for bathrooms, kitchens, and entry areas, while the best option depends on the room and how much wear it gets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic tile is often a strong choice for kitchens and bathrooms because it handles moisture well and is easy to clean. Compare it against your room’s traffic, water exposure, and budget.
